title: Typed K storage, row transfers, and block conversion
summary: PR4424 adds k_vnni_tensor, an owner for one key-data plane, and k_vnni_view, its typed borrowed view.
The operations map contiguous token rows to dimension-pair storage for vector and tile readers.
An incomplete token block can keep contiguous rows until an explicit conversion changes its layout.

terms.name: K / KV / QK
terms.meaning: K is cached key data. KV means key and value. QK scores compare query data with cached key data.

terms.name: bf16 / fp32
terms.meaning: bf16 is the 16-bit brain floating-point format. fp32 is the 32-bit IEEE floating-point format.

terms.name: VNNI / TRON_K_VNNI
terms.meaning: VNNI means Vector Neural Network Instructions. Here it names the layout that stores one dimension pair for each token in adjacent bf16 values. TRON_K_VNNI enables this storage for 128-dimension heads.

terms.name: AMX / AVX-512
terms.meaning: AMX means Advanced Matrix Extensions, the CPU tile instructions. AVX-512 means Advanced Vector Extensions, the CPU 512-bit vector instructions.

terms.name: DMA / FPGA
terms.meaning: DMA means direct memory access. FPGA means field-programmable gate array. The cache supplies DMA-backed storage; hardware staging copies cache rows for the FPGA.

terms.name: plane / panel / token block
terms.meaning: A plane is K for one KV head of one page. A panel is one dimension step × one token block: 1 KiB. A token block holds 16 tokens across 4 panels: 4 KiB.

terms.name: dimension pair / pair row / dword / lane
terms.meaning: A dimension pair contains 2 adjacent bf16 values. One pair row stores that pair for 16 tokens in 64 bytes. A dword is a 32-bit value. Each vector lane here holds one dword.

terms.name: row-major
terms.meaning: A token has 128 contiguous bf16 values in dimension order. A row-major block uses the same 4 panels as the corresponding VNNI block.

terms.name: Rows / Cols / s / c / dp / t / j
terms.meaning: Rows and Cols are the plane shape. s selects a 32-dimension step. c selects a 16-token block. dp selects a dimension pair. t selects a token within that block. j selects one of the pair’s 2 values.

terms.name: k_vnni_tensor / k_vnni_view
terms.meaning: The tensor owns plane bytes. The view borrows plane bytes and restricts access to typed operations.

terms.name: const_k_row_view / k_row_view
terms.meaning: These borrow one contiguous source row or writable destination row. Their Aligned and Dma template flags describe the caller’s buffer.

terms.name: present / FULL_BLOCK_0XFFFF
terms.meaning: present is a 16-bit mask with one bit for each token in a block. FULL_BLOCK_0XFFFF selects all 16 tokens.

terms.name: block_bit / offset_bit / BLOCKS_PER_PAGE_MASK_0XF
terms.meaning: block_bit selects one of a page’s 4 token blocks. offset_bit selects one of its 64 token offsets. BLOCKS_PER_PAGE_MASK_0XF selects all 4 blocks.

units.title: Define the fixed plane geometry and instruction-sized pieces
explanation: The storage shape is 64 tokens × 128 dimensions of bf16, or 16 KiB.
The packed plane contains 4 dimension steps × 4 token blocks.
Each panel contains 16 pair rows of 64 bytes.
The compile-time assertions prove that these constants preserve the row-major element count.
BF16_BITS_16 and HIGH_HALF_0XFFFF0000 describe exact widening of the pair halves to fp32 bit patterns.

units.title: Select packed storage by compile option and head size
explanation: With TRON_K_VNNI enabled, layout_on is true only for HEAD_SIZE_128.
Without the option, layout_on is false for every head size.

All users of one storage geometry therefore choose the same representation.

units.title: Transpose token rows into pair rows in registers
explanation: transpose_16x16_epi32 transposes a 16 × 16 matrix of dwords in place.
The first stage interleaves 32-bit lanes from pairs of input registers.
The next stage interleaves 64-bit groups from groups of 4 input registers.
Two quarter-shuffle stages finish the transpose.
The output register r[i] contains input lane i from every input register.

diagrams.caption: Each input register represents one token for one dimension step. Each output register represents one dimension pair across sixteen tokens.

coverage_notes: This is a new file in PR4424. All substantive nonblank lines are assigned to the units below. Some comments and assertions appear beside more than one related unit.
The diagrams describe source contracts and data movement. They do not report measured performance or claim that tests were run.
The page owns per-block layout state. A k_vnni_view does not carry that state, and callers must select packed or row-major operations correctly.
The header allows typed row/block operations and the documented score readers to compute packed addresses. book::fill_random is the documented whole-plane exception.
